title: Execution Update
description: execution-update/v2: the document an execution-updated event carries. One per leg of the trade's execution, whatever runs it: the first and second leg of one loan intent today, or two DvPs later. A leg completed or failed, or the plan was reset to an earlier instruction and runs again: a reset names the leg that runs again, the sequences it went from and to, and the exceptions on the trade it answers, which the event also cites. A guard cannot read the status, so the facade decides who reports which leg and when the last one has run.

orchestrationPlanId.description: The plan the leg ran in.

of.description: How many legs the execution has.

status.description: completed or failed for a leg that ran; reset when the plan was rewound to run this leg again.

completedAt.description: When the leg finished, epoch ms.

assets.description: What the leg moved, when the reporter knows it.

reset.description: Where the plan was reset, on a reset.

fromSequence.description: The instruction the reset was launched from.

targetSequence.description: The instruction the plan runs again from.

exceptionIds.description: On a reset, the open exceptions on the trade it answers, as the event cites them.
